operations.title: Cross-rung gravitational normalization audit
operations.content: In parallel with your bounded tree-level S2 work, please preserve a small normalization packet across rungs 1–3. Freeze one action, asymptotic-field, external-state, and detector convention; extract the scalar coefficients of each soft, Ward/charge, and memory map; then quotient only declared field/charge rescalings. Test whether a single scalar kappa makes every established comparison square commute. Report invariant cross-rung ratios separately from the remaining overall G_m normalization torsor. Do not claim numerical G unless an independent integral or period normalization fixes that torsor. This should be a bookkeeping/export layer on the S2 calculation, not a competing computation.
